summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Afrovending.com e-commerce platform. Backend APIs are fully functional (14/14 tests passed). Frontend loads correctly with all major sections. Found authentication flow issues on frontend.

ui_bugs.issue: Login form submission doesn't redirect user to homepage after successful login
User registration completes but user doesn't appear to be automatically logged in
affected_selectors: Login button still visible after registration

integration_issues.issue: Frontend auth state not properly syncing with backend authentication

passed_tests: Homepage loads with hero section, categories, and featured products
User registration flow - register new customer account
Vendor registration flow - register and redirect to vendor setup
Products page - listing, filtering by category, search functionality
Cart functionality - shows login prompt for unauthenticated users
All backend API endpoints working correctly
Trust badges and CTA buttons functional
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix frontend authentication flow - login form should redirect users after successful login and registration should automatically log users in. Check AuthContext implementation and token storage/retrieval.
